description: This file contains utility functions for certificate verification, including parsing certificates, comparing verification results, and handling specific certificate policies and error cases within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ParsedCertificate
classes.description: Represents a parsed X.509 certificate used for verification and policy checks.

classes.name: CertErrors
classes.description: Holds errors encountered during certificate parsing.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate with methods for accessing buffers and fingerprints.

classes.name: EVRootCAMetadata
classes.description: Provides metadata about EV root CA policies.

classes.name: CertVerifyResult
classes.description: Holds the result of a certificate verification process.

methods.name: ParsedCertificateFromBuffer
methods.description: Creates a ParsedCertificate from a buffer handle.

methods.name: ParsedCertificateListFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts a list of parsed certificates from an X509Certificate.

methods.name: CertHasMultipleEVPoliciesAndOneMatchesRoot
methods.description: Checks if a certificate has multiple EV policies with at least one matching the root.

methods.name: GetRootHash
methods.description: Calculates the fingerprint of the root certificate.

methods.name: CertVerifyResultEqual
methods.description: Compares two CertVerifyResult objects for equality.

methods.name: IsSynchronouslyIgnorableDifference
methods.description: Determines if differences between two verification results can be ignored based on specific criteria.
